standard.summary: DINOv2/Jina 权重所在设备。cpu=不占 GPU（推荐）；cuda=大卡 opt-in。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.cpu: 教师编码器放 CPU，不占训练显存，速度看 CPU/PCIe。
optionDescriptions.cuda: 教师放 GPU，快，但跟训练抢显存。

standard_en.summary: The device the DINOv2/Jina weights live on. cpu = does not take GPU memory (recommended); cuda = opt-in for a big card.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.cpu: The teacher encoder sits on the CPU, taking no training VRAM; the speed depends on your CPU and PCIe.
optionDescriptions.cuda: The teacher sits on the GPU: fast, but it competes with training for VRAM.

advanced.principle: DINOv2/Jina 权重所在设备。cpu=不占 GPU（推荐）；cuda=大卡 opt-in。

advanced_en.principle: Device holding the DINOv2/Jina weights. cpu = no GPU usage (recommended); cuda = opt-in on large cards.
